description:
`packages/rust` installs only `rustc,cargo,rust-std-<triple>,clippy-preview,rustfmt-preview` (`packages/rust/default.nix:47`). There is no `rust-src` component, so the built `rust-1.98.1/lib/rustlib/` has no `src/`.

The rust template exports `RUST_SRC_PATH = "${rust}/lib/rustlib/src/rust/library"` (`templates/rust/flake.nix:47`). In a template shell that path does not exist, so rust-analyzer gets no std sources.

Found by the EGM drift review on 2026-10-25.

## Acceptance

- `ls $(nix build --no-link --print-out-paths .#rust.default)/lib/rustlib/src/rust/library` lists the std crates.
- Adding the component is a new builder variant, or applies only to new versions, so existing rust drvPaths stay unchanged (AGENTS.md, Builder Versioning).
title: rust: ship rust-src so RUST_SRC_PATH resolves
